run_lighting_tutorial: run the lighting tutorial to demonstrate scene lighting configurations in Habitat-Sim simulator
create_light_setup: create a custom light setup using LightInfo with vector and LightPositionModel for the simulator
configure_simulator_with_lighting: configure the Habitat-Sim simulator with a custom scene light setup and override defaults
place_rigid_objects: place rigid objects like spheres and chairs in the scene using the object template manager
modify_existing_light_setup: modify an existing light setup by retrieving it and adding additional lights before re-registering
